anchors.paper_title: EEG Signal Dataset During Dorsiflexion and Plantar Flexion Movements
anchors.paper_venue: Zenodo (CERN European Organization for Nuclear Research)
anchors.reason: The Zenodo record (10.5281/zenodo.14672334) is the original deposit of this dataset: same authors, six participants, static/motion ankle exoskeleton, relaxation vs motor imagery.

anchors.paper_title: MNE-BIDS: Organizing electrophysiological data into the BIDS format and facilitating their analysis
anchors.paper_venue: The Journal of Open Source Software
anchors.reason: MNE-BIDS is a software tool for organizing electrophysiological data into BIDS, used for dataset formatting; it does not describe this ankle motor imagery dataset.

anchors.paper_title: EEG-BIDS, an extension to the brain imaging data structure for electroencephalography
anchors.reason: EEG-BIDS is a specification/extension of BIDS for EEG data that the dataset's format follows; it does not describe this ankle motor imagery dataset.

metadata.methods_description: EEG was recorded at 250 Hz from 28 EEG channels, 4 EOG channels and 3 miscellaneous channels, using a standard_1005 montage. Participants performed cue-based (auditory) kinesthetic motor imagery of ankle dorsiflexion/plantarflexion versus rest in 4 s trials, over 11 runs per session, in a static and a motion exoskeleton session.
